title: Ashmita Chaliha Storms Back to Win Maiden BWF World Tour Title at Korea Masters
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Ashmita Chaliha's victory at the Korea Masters marks her first BWF World Tour title and a significant comeback.
summary: The 26-year-old Indian player, Ashmita Chaliha, secured her maiden BWF World Tour title at the Korea Masters, capping a remarkable return to form after a career-threatening knee injury in 2024.

title: Ayush Shetty Ready to Face World No. 1 Shi Yu Qi at BWF World Championships
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty prepares for a tough opening round challenge against the world's top player at the prestigious BWF World Championships.
summary: Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty expresses confidence as he prepares to face Chinese world No. 1 Shi Yu Qi in the first round of the BWF World Championships in New Delhi, following Lakshya Sen's similar encounter last year.

title: Langur Mimics to Keep Monkeys Off World Badminton Venue in Delhi
indian_angle: This unique local solution highlights the distinct challenges and arrangements for the BWF World Championships being hosted in India.
summary: Men mimicking langur calls will be stationed at the BWF World Championships venue in New Delhi to deter macaque intruders, an unusual but necessary measure for the event.

title: PV Sindhu Reacts to Langur Mimics at BWF Worlds Venue in Delhi
indian_angle: India's star shuttler PV Sindhu shares her light-hearted reaction to the unique monkey deterrence strategy at the BWF World Championships hosted in her home country.
summary: Indian badminton star PV Sindhu commented on the organizers' plan to use langur mimics to keep monkeys away from the BWF World Championships venue in Delhi, finding humor in the situation.

title: SAI, BAI Go All Out to Ensure Hassle-Free BWF World Championships
indian_angle: The joint efforts of India's top sports bodies are crucial for the successful hosting of a major international badminton event on home soil.
summary: The Sports Authority of India (SAI) and the Badminton Association of India (BAI) are working diligently to ensure the smooth and successful conduct of the upcoming BWF World Championships.

title: Indian Team Coaching Camp for Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships
indian_angle: This camp is vital for nurturing the next generation of Indian badminton talent for international junior competitions.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.
